# GreeneDesk

> GreeneDesk is Australian-built software for swim schools, leisure centres, councils and fitness teams in Australia and New Zealand. All customer data is hosted on AWS in Sydney, Australia. GreeneDesk works alongside existing management systems such as PerfectGym instead of replacing them.

## Company

- Legal name: GreeneDesk Pty Ltd
- ABN: 80 161 808 144 · ACN: 161 808 144
- Based in: Victoria, Australia
- Operating since: 2013
- Customers: 50+ centres across Australia and New Zealand, 500,000+ members
- Support: 1300 181 665, Monday to Friday 7am–7pm AEST, Australian-based team
- Data hosting: AWS Sydney (ap-southeast-2), Australia

## Who GreeneDesk is for

- **PerfectGym centres** that want fitness-floor tools without replacing PerfectGym: FitDesk plugs into PerfectGym through a customer-authorised API integration.
- **Technogym Mywellness users** who need member and health data hosted in Australia: FitDesk replaces Mywellness software (not Technogym equipment) and runs on AWS Sydney.
- **Swim schools and aquatic centres**, including those moving from iClassPro or other class-management software: SwimDesk runs lessons, school programs and squads in one Australian-hosted platform, with mobile apps for all users and AI retention alerts.
- **Councils and multi-site leisure centres** running aquatic, fitness and school programs across sites.

## Products

- [SwimDesk](https://greenedesk.com.au/solutions/swimdesk): swim school and aquatic centre software that runs learn-to-swim, school swimming programs and competitive squads on one platform. Class scheduling and online bookings, poolside attendance and skills assessments (offline tablet mode), progression tracking, digital certificates, term-based and recurring billing. Mobile apps for every user: instructors, coaches, office staff and parents (bookings, absences, make-up classes, progress). AI retention alerts flag students at risk of not re-enrolling. Supports AUSTSWIM, Royal Life Saving and YMCA curricula or your own syllabus.
  - [School Programs module](https://greenedesk.com.au/solutions/school-programs): school group bookings, attendance and reporting across sites.
  - [Squads module](https://greenedesk.com.au/solutions/squads): squad groups, coaching sessions and athlete progress.
- [FitDesk](https://greenedesk.com.au/solutions/fitdesk): fitness operations software. Digital PARQ and health consultations, assessments and member history, workout programming with 4,000+ exercise videos, trainer and resource scheduling, member app, progress, milestone and retention workflows, active ageing and rehabilitation programs.
- [FitDesk for PerfectGym](https://greenedesk.com.au/integrations/perfectgym): keep PerfectGym for memberships, billing and access control; add FitDesk for the fitness floor.
- [SportDesk](https://greenedesk.com.au/solutions/sportdesk): squads, coaching and structured sports programs.
- [SooperVision](https://soopervision.com.au/): AI supervision risk alerts for childcare centres using existing CCTV (separate site).

## Pricing

SwimDesk is priced by active enrolments: Essentials (up to 500), Professional (501–1,500) and Enterprise (1,500+). Plans start from A$350 per month; annual billing saves 15%. FitDesk is priced by membership volume: Basic (up to 150 members), FitDesk+ (151–500) and Enterprise (500+). Plans start from A$550 per month; annual billing saves 15%. See [Pricing](https://greenedesk.com.au/pricing).
